👥 The Two Contributors

This game was built collaboratively by two contributors: the human creator who came up with the ideas, features, characters, and feedback, and ChatGPT, the AI assistant that helped write and update the code. The game grew through their back-and-forth work, testing, bug reports, and new ideas.
